SRS_PWM_3 Yes SWS_Pwm_50075 Pwm.c shall include Pwm.h, Det.h and .
SRS_PWM_4 Yes SWS_Pwm_70075 Pwm_Irq.c shall include Pwm.h.
SRS_PWM_5 Yes SWS_Pwm_00088 All functions from the PWM module except Pwm_Init, Pwm_DeInit and Pwm_GetVersionInfo shall be re-entrant for different PWM channel numbers.
SRS_PWM_6 Yes SWS_Pwm_00089 The Pwm module’s user shall ensure the integrity if several function calls are made during run time in different tasks or ISRs for the same PWM channel.
SRS_PWM_7 Yes SWS_Pwm_00070 All time units used within the API services of the PWM module shall be of the unit ticks.
SRS_PWM_19 Yes SWS_Pwm_00058 The width of the duty cycle parameter is 16 Bits.
SRS_PWM_20 Yes SWS_Pwm_00059 The Pwm module shall comply with the following scaling scheme for the duty cycle: • 0x0000 means 0%. • 0x8000 means 100%. 0x8000 gives the highest resolution while allowing 100% duty cycle to be represented with a 16 bit value.
SRS_PWM_21 Yes SWS_Pwm_00201 Definiton of development errors in module Pwm
SRS_PWM_22 Yes SWS_Pwm_20002 The PWM Driver module shall report the development error PWM_E_UNINIT, when API service is used without module initialization.
SRS_PWM_23 Yes SWS_Pwm_30002 The PWM Driver module shall report the development error PWM_E_PARAM_CHANNEL, when API service is used with an invalid channel Identifier.
SRS_PWM_24 Yes SWS_Pwm_40002 The PWM Driver module shall report the development error PWM_E_PERIOD_UNCHANGEABLE, on usage of unauthorized PWM service on PWM channel configured a fixed period.
SRS_PWM_25 Yes SWS_Pwm_50002 The PWM Driver module shall report the development error PWM_E_ALREADY_INITIALIZED, when API Pwm_Init service is called while the PWM driver has already been initialized.
SRS_PWM_31 Yes SWS_Pwm_00094 Definition of imported datatypes of module Pwm
SRS_PWM_32 Yes SWS_Pwm_00106 Definition of datatype Pwm_ChannelType
SRS_PWM_33 Yes SWS_Pwm_00107 Definition of datatype Pwm_PeriodType
SRS_PWM_34 Yes SWS_Pwm_00108 Definition of datatype Pwm_OutputStateType
SRS_PWM_35 Yes SWS_Pwm_00109 Definition of datatype Pwm_EdgeNotificationType
SRS_PWM_36 Yes SWS_Pwm_00110 Definition of datatype Pwm_ChannelClassType
SRS_PWM_37 Yes SWS_Pwm_00111 Definition of datatype Pwm_ConfigType
SRS_PWM_40 Yes SWS_Pwm_00095 Definition of API function Pwm_Init
SRS_PWM_41 Yes SWS_Pwm_00007 The function Pwm_Init shall initialize all internals variables and the used PWM structure of the microcontroller according to the parameters specified in ConfigPtr.
SRS_PWM_42 Yes SWS_Pwm_00062 The function Pwm_Init shall only initialize the configured resources and shall not touch resources that are not configured in the configuration file.
SRS_PWM_43 Yes SWS_Pwm_10009 The function Pwm_Init shall start all PWM channels with the configured default values.
SRS_PWM_44 Yes SWS_Pwm_20009 0% or 100% : Then the PWM output signal shall be in the state according to the configured polarity parameter
SRS_PWM_45 Yes SWS_Pwm_30009 >0% and <100%: Then the PWM output signal shall be modulated according to parameters period, duty cycle and configured polarity.
SRS_PWM_46 Yes SWS_Pwm_00052 The function Pwm_Init shall disable all notifications.
SRS_PWM_47 Yes SWS_Pwm_00093 The users of the Pwm module shall not call the function Pwm_Init during a running operation.
SRS_PWM_48 Yes SWS_Pwm_00116 The Pwm module’s environment shall not call any function of the Pwm module before having called Pwm_Init.
SRS_PWM_49 Yes SWS_Pwm_00118 If development error detection is enabled, calling the routine Pwm_Init while the PWM driver and hardware are already initialized will cause a development error PWM_E_ALREADY_INITIALIZED. The desired functionality shall be left without any action.
SRS_PWM_50 Yes SWS_Pwm_00121 A re-initialization of the Pwm driver by executing the Pwm_Init function requires a de-initialization before by executing a Pwm_DeInit.
SRS_PWM_51 Yes SWS_Pwm_00096 Definition of API function Pwm_DeInit
SRS_PWM_52 Yes SWS_Pwm_00010 The function Pwm_DeInit shall de-initialize the PWM module.
SRS_PWM_53 Yes SWS_Pwm_00011 The function Pwm_DeInit shall set the state of the PWM output signals to the idle state.
SRS_PWM_54 Yes SWS_Pwm_00012 The function Pwm_DeInit shall disable PWM interrupts and PWM signal edge notifications.
SRS_PWM_55 Yes SWS_Pwm_10080 The function Pwm_DeInit shall be pre compile time configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: PwmDeInitApi.
SRS_PWM_56 Yes SWS_Pwm_20080 The function Pwm_DeInit shall be configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter PwmDeInitApi {PWM_DE_INIT_API}. Regarding error detection, the requirements [SWS_Pwm_00117], [SWS_Pwm_10051], and [SWS_Pwm_20051] are applicable to the function Pwm_DeInit.
SRS_PWM_57 Yes SWS_Pwm_91000 Definition of API function Pwm_SetDutyCycle
SRS_PWM_58 Yes SWS_Pwm_00013 The function Pwm_SetDutyCycle shall set the duty cycle of the PWM channel.
SRS_PWM_59 Yes SWS_Pwm_00014 When the requested duty cycle is either 0% or 100%, the function Pwm_SetDutyCycle shall set the PWM output state to either PWM_HIGH or PWM_LOW, with regard to both the configured polarity parameter and the requested duty cycle. Thus for 0% requested Duty Cycle the output will be the inverse of the configured polarity parameter, and for 100% Duty Cycle the output will be equal to the configured polarity parameter.
SRS_PWM_60 Yes SWS_Pwm_00016 The function Pwm_SetDutyCycle shall modulate the PWM output signal according to parameters period, duty cycle and configured polarity, when the duty cycle > 0 % and < 100%.
SRS_PWM_61 Yes SWS_Pwm_00017 The function Pwm_SetDutyCycle shall update the duty cycle always at the end of the period if supported by the implementation and configured with PwmDutycycleUpdatedEndperiod.
SRS_PWM_62 Yes SWS_Pwm_00018 The driver shall forbid the spike on the PWM output signal.
SRS_PWM_63 Yes SWS_Pwm_10082 The function Pwm_SetDutyCycle shall be pre compile time configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: PwmSetDutyCycle.
SRS_PWM_64 Yes SWS_Pwm_20082 The function Pwm_SetDutyCycle shall be configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: PwmSetDutyCycle {PWM_SET_DUTY_CYCLE_API}.
SRS_PWM_65 Yes SWS_Pwm_91001 Definition of API function Pwm_SetPeriodAndDuty
SRS_PWM_66 Yes SWS_Pwm_00019 The function Pwm_SetPeriodAndDuty shall set the period and the duty cycle of a PWM channel.
SRS_PWM_67 Yes SWS_Pwm_00076 The function Pwm_SetPeriodAndDuty shall update the period always at the end of the current period if supported by the implementation and configured with PwmPeriodUpdatedEndperiod.
SRS_PWM_68 Yes SWS_Pwm_00020 When updating the PWM period and duty, the driver shall repress any spikes on the PWM output signal.
SRS_PWM_69 Yes SWS_Pwm_00041 The function Pwm_SetPeriodAndDuty shall allow changing the period only for the PWM channel declared as variable Period type.
SRS_PWM_70 Yes SWS_Pwm_10083 The function Pwm_SetPeriodAndDuty shall be pre compile time configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: PwmSetPeriodAndDuty.
SRS_PWM_71 Yes SWS_Pwm_20083 The function Pwm_SetPeriodAndDuty shall be configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: PwmSetPeriodAndDuty {PWM_SET_PERIOD_AND_DUTY_API}.
SRS_PWM_72 Yes SWS_Pwm_00150 If the period is set to zero the setting of the duty-cycle is not relevant. In this case the output shall be zero (zero percent duty-cycle).
SRS_PWM_73 Yes SWS_Pwm_91002 Definition of API function Pwm_SetOutputToIdle
SRS_PWM_74 Yes SWS_Pwm_00021 The function Pwm_SetOutputToIdle shall set immediately the PWM output to the configured Idle state.
SRS_PWM_75 Yes SWS_Pwm_10084 The function Pwm_SetOutputToIdle shall be pre compile time configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: PwmSetOutputToIdle.
SRS_PWM_76 Yes SWS_Pwm_20084 The function Pwm_SetOutputToIdle shall be configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: PwmSetOutputToIdle {PWM_SET_OUTPUT_TO_IDLE_API}.
SRS_PWM_77 Yes SWS_Pwm_10086 After the call of the function Pwm_SetOutputToIdle, variable period type channels shall be reactivated using the Api Pwm_SetPeriodAndDuty to activate the PWM channel with the new passed period.
SRS_PWM_78 Yes SWS_Pwm_20086 After the call of the function Pwm_SetOutputToIdle, channels shall be reactivated using the Api Pwm_SetDutyCycle to activate the PWM channel with the old period.
SRS_PWM_79 Yes SWS_Pwm_00119 After the call of the function Pwm_SetOutputToIdle, fixed period type channels shall be reactivated using only the API Pwm_SetDutyCycle to activate the PWM channel with the old period.
SRS_PWM_80 Yes SWS_Pwm_00100 Definition of API function Pwm_GetOutputState
SRS_PWM_81 Yes SWS_Pwm_00022 The function Pwm_GetOutputState shall read the internal state of the PWM output signal and return it as defined in the diagram below.
SRS_PWM_82 Yes SWS_Pwm_10085 The function Pwm_GetOutputState shall be pre compile time configurable On/Off using the configuration parameter: PwmGetOutputState.
SRS_PWM_83 Yes SWS_Pwm_20085 The function Pwm_GetOutputState shall be configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: PwmGetOutputState {PWM_GET_OUTPUT_STATE_API}. Due to real time constraint and setting of the PWM channel (project dependant), the output state can be modified just after the call of the service Pwm_GetOutputState.
SRS_PWM_84 Yes SWS_Pwm_30051 If Pwm_GetOutputState is called before module initialization, or with an invalid channel, it shall return PWM_LOW.
SRS_PWM_85 Yes SWS_Pwm_91003 Definition of API function Pwm_DisableNotification
SRS_PWM_86 Yes SWS_Pwm_00023 The function Pwm_DisableNotification shall disable the PWM signal edge notification.
SRS_PWM_87 Yes SWS_Pwm_10112 The function Pwm_DisableNotification shall be pre compile time configurable On/Off using the configuration parameter: PwmNotificationSupported.
SRS_PWM_88 Yes SWS_Pwm_20112 The function Pwm_DisableNotification shall be configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: PwmNotificationSupported {PWM_NOTIFICATION_SUPPORTED}.
SRS_PWM_89 Yes SWS_Pwm_91004 Definition of API function Pwm_EnableNotification
SRS_PWM_90 Yes SWS_Pwm_00024 The function Pwm_EnableNotification shall enable the PWM signal edge notification according to notification parameter.
SRS_PWM_91 Yes SWS_Pwm_00081 The function Pwm_EnableNotification shall cancel pending interrupts.
SRS_PWM_92 Yes SWS_Pwm_10113 The function Pwm_EnableNotification shall be pre compile time configurable On/Off using the configuration parameter: PwmNotificationSupported.
SRS_PWM_93 Yes SWS_Pwm_20113 The function Pwm_EnableNotification shall be configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: PwmNotificationSupported {PWM_NOTIFICATION_SUPPORTED}.

SRS_PWM_126 Yes SWS_Pwm_00025 The Pwm module shall call the function Pwm_Notification_<#Channel> accordingly to the last call of Pwm_EnableNotification and Pwm_DisableNotification for channel <#Channel>.
SRS_PWM_127 Yes SWS_Pwm_00026 The Pwm module shall reset the interrupt flag associated to the notification Pwm_Notification_<#Channel>
SRS_PWM_128 Yes SWS_Pwm_10115 The Pwm module shall provide the functionality of Pwm_EnableNotification only when the configuration parameter PwmNotificationSupported is ON.
SRS_PWM_129 Yes SWS_Pwm_20115 The Pwm module shall provide the functionality of Pwm_DisableNotification only when the configuration parameter PwmNotificationSupported is ON.

SRS_PWM_134 Yes SWS_Pwm_20051 If development error detection for the Pwm module is enabled, and a development error occurs, then the corresponding PWM function shall skip the desired functionality in order to avoid any corruptions of data or hardware registers leaving the function without any actions.
SRS_PWM_135 Yes SWS_Pwm_00117 If development error detection for the Pwm module is enabled: if any function (except Pwm_Init) is called before Pwm_Init has been called, the called function shall raise development error PWM_E_UNINIT.
SRS_PWM_136 Yes SWS_Pwm_00045 If development error detection for the Pwm module is enabled: The API Pwm_SetPeriodAndDuty shall check if the given PWM channel is of the channel class type PWM_VARIABLE_PERIOD. If this is not the case the development error PWM_E_PERIOD_UNCHANGEABLE shall be called.
SRS_PWM_137 Yes SWS_Pwm_00047 If development error detection for the Pwm module is enabled: the PWM functions shall check the parameter ChannelNumber and raise development error PWM_E_PARAM_CHANNEL if the parameter ChannelNumber is invalid.
